prompt:
Refine this SAME ashlar wall sprite. Preserve exact stone layout, ALL unique long/short block silhouettes, continuous flat coping, two large horizontal courses, camera, boundaries and overall brightness. Keep LARGE obvious square pixels, the same square-cell size as current image. Do not add more courses or alter the scale.
The broad gray stone faces are too flat when restored to a native grid with50 colors. Repaint those surfaces with rich, MEANINGFUL carved-stone micro-relief in1-3-pixel clusters: shallow angular flake scars with dark lower rims and warm upper lips; gray-beige mineral veins crossing just one block; interrupted narrow rain streaks; small connected lichen lobes; worn chisel facets on another block; tiny low-contrast cool gray pits embedded in gray stone. Make these DIFFERENT for each stone. Existing large crack remains on only one block. Not repeated W moss, no duplicate shapes.
Every native surface pixel should have deliberate nearby muted shade variation much like a finely crafted96px game hero; avoid flat untextured areas larger than4x4 cells. Keep rich44-50-color style: multiple close gray/warmgray/coolgray shades, sparse olive moss and gray lichen, dark recesses. Fine detail must be organized around geology, rain and weathering, NEVER random noise/salt-pepper dots, checkerboard dithering or photorealistic grain. Exposed chips and pits are angular marks, not little circular pebbles.
Do not brighten stone globally; no ivory shine, no cyan. Flat square pixel blocks only; NO information finer than one visible block, no AA or blurred gradients. Complete long rectangular dressed-ASHLAR wall, not rounded rubble. A thick dark wet mud contact band with pressed DARK olive-brown grass and distinct gray fragments, not bright orange. Keep surrounding backdrop pure#FF00FF. No labels, frames, ground shadow, posts or extra objects.

first.prompt:
Create ONE standalone COMPLETE ASHLAR cemetery wall sprite. True high-detail LARGE-SQUARE PIXEL ART, not a realistic painting and not fine micro-pixel texture.
References:1 broken ashlar wall locks the exact rectangular dressed-stone material, muted gray/olive colors, lichen and course heights.2 gate pillar locks the mason's stone type.3 B1 locks individual pixel-square size and detail richness.4 is ONLY the scale/course envelope, not art: same wide canvas, a short wall55 native cells tall,160 cells long. Native canvas208x96 shown as8x zoom. Every logical square is a flat big8x8 block; all fine details are 1-3 such cells. No smaller output texture.
The wall MUST have just TWO horizontal courses of RECTANGULAR LONG dressed ashlar blocks, plus a low continuous coping band. Lower course40% height; upper course40%; coping20%. Main joint runs horizontally, straight baseline. Long/short block lengths vary roughly22-50 native pixels and vertical joints stagger; no round fieldstones, no three-course rubble. Same gray stone mason as refs1and2. Each block is UNIQUE: one broad long block with a diagonal crack at left, a shorter chipped-corner block, a long gray block with one faint rain streak, one block with a small lichen island on its RIGHT bottom, a largely clean weathered block. Olive moss mostly in mortar and foot, NOT W-shaped repeated moss. NO duplicated stones, mirrored clones or repeating stamp. Different low broad coping slabs with unequal widths, top is continuous roughly level within2px, NEVER evenly spaced teeth/battlements.
Upperleft diffuse light; warm-gray chipped edges, cooler wet gray faces, olive moss and gray-beige lichen; subtle rich material variation in40-48 shades. High detail comparable to B1, at least80% of horizontal neighboring cells differ meaningfully, but don't add random noise. Every cluster represents pitting, stain, lichen, fracture or bevel.
Both ends are clean vertical CUTS of a continuous wall, SAME HEIGHT: no endposts, no projecting pedestals, no decorative terminal caps, no perspectives making the far end lower. Modest top depth visible from overhead but long front face stays horizontal. A THICK LOW contact band of dark damp sunken mud, compressed DARK olive-brown grass and a few gray chips, not a thin line, not bright orange. Entire full wall visible, generous solid #FF00FF backdrop, no floor plane or cast shadow. No blue-green/cyan, glow, text, grid, labels, AA, blur, smooth gradients or photographic texture.
